name: fixmycity
description: FixMyCity: One City. One Platform. Every Service. A unified platform for civic issue reporting, complaint tracking, utility services and city information.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fixmycity/api && npm run build -w @fixmycity/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run start -w @fixmycity/api" "npm run start -w @fixmycity/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fixmycity/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fixmycity/api && npm run typecheck -w @fixmycity/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @fixmycity/api && npm run lint -w @fixmycity/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fixmycity/shared && npm run test -w @fixmycity/api
